title: heare S2S-realtime Phase 1 (OpenRouter pivot)
notes: v3: pivoted from claude -p to OpenRouter SSE per ADR-002 (2026-04-18). See .omc/benchmarks/phase1-openrouter.md. ADR-002 consequences: (a) US-P1-01 v2 name `GeneratorCLI` renamed to `OpenRouterCLI` (src/openrouter_cli.py); (b) US-P1-02 v2 ACs requiring a separate generator_workspace_dir + empty .mcp.json seeding are VOIDED — OpenRouter is an HTTP client, not a subprocess, so there is no cwd or MCP inheritance to isolate. US-P1-02 retained for the config-fields deliverable only.
